question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: We believe that many of the lawsuts they have initiated would destroy the integrity of our elections.
We believe that many of the lawsuits they have initiated would destroy the intigrity of our elections.
We beleve that many of the lawsuits they have initiated would destroy the integrity of our elections.
We believe that many of the lawsuits they have initiated would destroy the integrity of our elections.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lawsuits"** means a claim or dispute brought to a court of law for adjudication. (मुकदमे)
 
 
• **Example: **The company faced several lawsuits over its product safety standards.
 
 
 
• **"Integrity" **refers to the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. (अखंडता)
 
 
• **Example: **Her integrity and dedication to the job were never in question.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: **lawsuts (मुकदमे): This is a spelling error. The correct word should be "lawsuits".
 
 
• **Example:** The company faced several lawsuits over its product safety standards.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: **intigrity (अखंडता): This is a spelling error. The correct word should be "integrity".
 
 
• **Example: **Her integrity and dedication to the job were never in question.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: **beleve (विश्वास): This is a spelling error. The correct word should be "believe".
 
 
• **Example:** I believe that honesty is the best policy.
 
 

Question 1: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
